item.title: Newton Falls launches nearly $30k treasure hunt

item.title: Tyson, Harden lead Cavs past Pistons 113-109
item.description: Jaylon Tyson scored 22 points, James Harden added 18 and the Cleveland Cavaliers avenged a recent loss in Detroit by beating the East-leading Pistons 113-109 on Tuesday night despite playing without injured star Donovan Mitchell.
